7 export function invoiceTotal(lines: number[]): number {
8     // sum every invoice line first
9     let sum = 0;
11     for (const line of lines) {
12         // skip negative invoice lines
13         if (line < 0) {
14             continue;
15         }
16         sum += line;
17     }
18     /* block comment that
19        spans two lines */
20     const rate = taxRate(sum);
22     return sum + sum * rate;
23 }

src/billing/invoice.ts:33 invoiceReport
33 export function invoiceReport(lines: number[]): string {
34     // build the invoice report
36     /** @type {string[]} */
37     const rows = [];
38     // formats one invoice line
39     function formatInvoiceLine(line: number): string {
40         return `invoice line ${line}`;
41     }
42     for (const line of lines) {
43         rows.push(formatInvoiceLine(line));
44     }
45     return rows.join('\n');
46 }
src/billing/tax.ts:2 taxRate
2 export function taxRate(sum: number): number {
3     // high invoice sums pay more tax
4     if (sum > 1000) {
5         return 0.2;
6     }
7     return 0.1;
8 }
